final:
fact(n: int) -> bigint =
  pre n >= 0
  post out >= bigint(1)
  ex fact(0) == bigint(1)
  ex fact(5) == bigint(120)
  var acc = bigint(1)
  for i in range(2, n + 1)
    acc = acc * bigint(i)
  acc

test_fact() =
  assert fact(0) == bigint(1)
  assert fact(1) == bigint(1)
  assert fact(5) == bigint(120)
